# OpenAI Codex Changelog — captured 2026-05-25

## May 21, 2026 — Version 26.519: Appshots, Goal Mode, and Remote Computer Use

### Appshots (macOS only)
Press both Command keys to send the frontmost app window to Codex with a screenshot.
Injects screenshot of frontmost window plus any text the app exposes (including content outside the visible scroll area) into the current thread as an attachment.

### Goal Mode (GA)
Transitioned from experimental to standard feature.
Enables extended multi-hour objective tracking across app, IDE extension, and CLI.
Now live in Codex app, VS Code and JetBrains extensions, and CLI 0.128.0+.

### Remote Computer Use
Codex can access desktop applications after device lock.
Remote operation via Codex Mobile possible even when Mac screen is off and locked.
Safety: time-bound authorization, covered screen, relock at first local input, manual unlock fallback.

### Plugin Sharing
ChatGPT Business teams can distribute reusable plugin bundles through marketplace sources.

### Browser Improvements
Enhanced image asset extraction speed.
Structured data retrieval with read-only JavaScript sandbox.

### Chrome Extension Refinements
Reduced tab clutter by removing tab group creation during task handoff.

## Codex CLI 0.133.0
- Goals function by default with dedicated storage and progress tracking across turns
- `codex remote-control` operates as foreground command with improved readiness reporting
- Permission profiles expanded with list APIs, inheritance support, and Windows sandbox integration
- Plugin discovery enhanced with marketplace-aware output and remote collection support
- Extensions gain additional lifecycle event visibility including subagent transitions and tool execution

## May 20, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.132.0
Python SDK authentication enhancements: API key login, ChatGPT browser flow, device-code flows.
Text-based workflows accept plain strings.
